notes: Records are protocol-specific archived evaluations; repeated inputs across protocols or judge pairs are retained.
generation_target is a search instruction, not independently verified ground truth.
proxy_label comes from the historical unified_judge output, not human annotation.

The paper failure-mode analysis uses 1681 TVD records after excluding 21 manually flagged judge-output artifacts. This export preserves all 1702 archives; no source exclusion-ID list was available to reconstruct that analysis subset.

Historical scoring selection differs: TVD uses normalized score gap >0.5; the attack conflict archive uses disagreement in attack-success labels (normalized success threshold 0.75). This is distinct from the score-gap metric reported for the complete attack audit. Each record preserves its collection rule.
